subject.title: fix(signal): preserve native quote replies from agent sends

question: Should prepareSendPayload permanently expose the existing explicit-versus-implicit reply provenance to channel plugins?
rationale: Signal needs the distinction to preserve explicit native replies without persisting inherited intent, but adding it to a plugin-facing contract is a compatibility choice requiring contract-owner approval.

options.title: Approve the provenance seam
options.body: Keep the optional field, type it from the canonical reply-provenance definition, and validate sibling adapters after refreshing the branch.

options.title: Use a Signal-private seam
options.body: Remove the plugin API expansion and carry explicit reply intent through an existing Signal-owned context or payload path.

recommendation.title: Approve the provenance seam
recommendation.body: Keep the optional field, type it from the canonical reply-provenance definition, and validate sibling adapters after refreshing the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this owner most directly to the message-action plugin contract being expanded.
